GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr.reason: Build-time denial of service only. The fix is published in image-size 2.0.3, but Metro 0.83 requires image-size ^1.0.2 and passes filenames to its synchronous API, while image-size 2.0.3 requires image bytes, so overriding to 2.x would break the Metro build. The local image-size patch guards malformed ICNS entries and zero-sized image boxes. Scope is limited to Metro dependency paths from the mobile and Android TV projects; remove this waiver when the advisory disappears or any path leaves that scope.
